major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon it when Zenith is ready and no Heart of the Jade Serpent is running, then use the window it opens to channel Celestial Conduit.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id, seen in 4/5 sampled parses; the Shado-pan build skips it, hence talent_gated.

major_cooldowns.name: Zenith
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: It holds two charges, so time one for a burst window with your stat buffs and then fill with free Blackout Kicks to pull Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury back faster.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast and self aura share id 1249625. Base cooldown 90s with two charges; talents can bring it to 60, 70 or 80s.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it only once the Heart of the Jade Serpent from Strike of the Windlord or Whirling Dragon Punch has faded, and cancel the channel with your next global.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 443028; 1248992 is the self aura that opens the post-Xuen cast window. Conduit of the Celestials hero talent only.

major_cooldowns.name: Whirling Dragon Punch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it the moment Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury are both on cooldown, and delay it when Invoke Xuen is about to come up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 152175; 196742 is the self aura that marks it as available.

major_cooldowns.name: Strike of the Windlord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown unless Invoke Xuen is about to come up or Celestial Conduit already has Heart of the Jade Serpent running.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Castable per tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses, so no top parse ran this talent.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it as soon as it is up whenever you can fit it without delaying a rotational ability, and keep it out of your Zenith window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 180s; Fatal Touch (394123) cuts it by 90s when talented.

major_cooldowns.name: Slicing Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it just before the pull and then send it whenever nothing higher on the priority is ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Castable per tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses; it is a build variant.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it just before Zenith so the stats are already up for the window, and spend the second one as the fight ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Consumable cast id, used in 5/5 sampled parses; the guide times stat buffs ahead of Zenith.

defensives.name: Touch of Karma
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on your target for a hit you can absorb, and press it anyway when nothing is incoming for the damage it redirects.
defensives.id_note: Cast id 122470; 125174 is the self aura and 124280 the enemy debuff.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Use it before Touch of Death or Touch of Karma so the extra maximum health is snapshot into both.
defensives.id_note: Cast id 115203; 120954 is the self aura.

rules.description: Open Tiger Palm, Zenith, Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick
rules.action: Lead with Tiger Palm, fire Zenith alongside your stat buffs, then Fists of Fury into Rising Sun Kick.

rules.description: Hold Whirling Dragon Punch and Windlord for Xuen
rules.action: Sit on both once Invoke Xuen is close and send them after the summon.
Dump Chi on a spender first so both Chi from Tiger Palm have room to land.

rules.description: Spend Dance of Chi-Ji on Spinning Crane Kick
rules.action: Work Spinning Crane Kick into your next global while the proc is live.
